confidence_notes: FX is the RBA AUD/USD rate of 0.6720 as at 18 November 2026, taken from search results for the RBA exchange-rates page. I ran one search for food and drink prices. It returned crowd-sourced Wollongong cost-of-living pages that disagreed with each other and were partly undated. The cappuccino and inexpensive-meal anchors are bounded estimates from those pages. Beer is based on the local pint at roughly A$9-10. Cocktail and wine were not found directly. I set them from the usual Australian relationship to beer, with cocktails at about 2x and a wine glass at about 1.2-1.4x. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Wollongong, a coastal city south of Sydney with university and beach-tourism demand. I did not check any listings or booking pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to mid-sized Australian coastal regional cities such as Newcastle, Gold Coast and Geelong. Prices sit slightly below Sydney.
